  tl = GoInterface.nil

  [go!"Infof", go!"Debugf",

    meth l.v)) (intoVal format)) (intoVal args)) {{ Φ }}

    TraceLoggerOkS tr tl) : TraceLoggerOk tl

def TraceLoggerOkS (tr : Option GName) (tl : GoInterface) : Prop :=
  match tr with
  | none => TraceLoggerOk tl
  | some val => True

  iprop(∀ meth x format args,
      □
        ∀ Φ,
          True -∗
            ▷ (True -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
              WP (((intoVal (methods l.ty meth l.v)) (intoVal format)) (intoVal args)) {{ Φ }})
